resources.name: 2-1-1 Colorado (United Way of Larimer County)
resources.description: Free, confidential help line that connects you with food, housing, utility help, health care and more anywhere in Larimer County. Call, text your ZIP code to 898-211, or search online.

resources.name: 988 Colorado Mental Health Line
resources.description: Call or text 988 any time for free, confidential support with emotional, mental health or substance use concerns. The old Colorado Crisis Services number (1-844-493-8255) now routes here too.

resources.name: SummitStone Health Partners - Crisis Services
resources.description: Larimer County's community mental health provider. Walk-in crisis care at Longview Acute Care (2260 W Trilby Rd, Fort Collins) is open 24/7. Also offers counseling, substance use treatment and Medicaid-friendly outpatient care.
resources.address: 2260 W Trilby Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Crossroads Safehouse
resources.description: 24-hour help for anyone experiencing domestic violence: emergency shelter, safety planning, advocacy and legal help. Confidential and free.
resources.address: 421 Parker St, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Alternatives to Violence
resources.description: Loveland's domestic violence and sexual assault agency. 24-hour crisis line (text 970-669-5157), emergency shelter, advocacy and counseling.
resources.address: 541 E 8th St, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Estes Valley Crisis Advocates
resources.description: Support for victims of domestic violence, sexual assault and other crimes in the Estes Valley. After hours, call Estes Park Police dispatch at 970-586-4000 and ask for an advocate.
resources.address: Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Food Bank for Larimer County - Fort Collins
resources.description: Free groceries through the Fresh Food Share market. Shop like a grocery store, no cost. No paperwork needed for your first visit; bring an ID if you have one.
resources.address: 1301 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Food Bank for Larimer County - Loveland
resources.description: Free groceries through the Fresh Food Share market in Loveland. Also the pickup point for senior food boxes (CSFP) for adults 60+.
resources.address: 2600 N Lincoln Ave, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Vindeket Foods
resources.description: Pay-what-you-can grocery market that rescues surplus food. Everyone is welcome; pay nothing if you need to. No questions asked.
resources.address: 1317 Webster Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: FoCo Cafe
resources.description: Pay-what-you-can restaurant serving a healthy lunch to everyone. Pay what you can afford, volunteer an hour for a meal, or eat free.
resources.address: 225 Maple St, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Food Not Bombs - Fort Collins
resources.description: Volunteer group that shares free meals and groceries. No paperwork, no questions. They serve with Clothe the People. The Oak Street Mennonite Fellowship building they used is closed, so the spot can move. Check Instagram before you go.
resources.hours: Often Wed 5-7pm and Sunday afternoon; some Thu/Sat park shares. Confirm this week's location on Instagram.

resources.name: UCHealth Family Medicine Center Food Pantry
resources.description: Free food pantry open to anyone in the community, located inside the Family Medicine Center. Ask at the front desk for Suite 109.
resources.address: 1025 Pennock Pl, Suite 109, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Salvation Army - Fort Collins
resources.description: Food pantry, free breakfast (Mon, Wed, Thu 8:30-9:30am), clothing help and seasonal assistance. Call ahead for pantry hours.
resources.address: 3901 S Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: St. John's Lutheran Church Food Pantry
resources.description: Weekly food pantry and clothing closet open to anyone in need. No proof of income required.
resources.address: 305 E Elizabeth St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Mobile Food Pantry at Foothills Unitarian Church
resources.description: Food Bank for Larimer County mobile pantry with free fresh produce and groceries. Drive-through or walk up.
resources.address: 1815 Yorktown Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: NoCo CommUNITY Store
resources.description: Free community pantry and clothing closet run by volunteers. Take what you need; no paperwork.
resources.address: 120 W Saturn Dr, Unit A, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Call 2-1-1 or check their social pages for current hours

resources.name: House of Neighborly Service - Loveland
resources.description: Food pantry, clothing, hygiene items, and help with rent, utilities and prescriptions for people in the Loveland area.
resources.address: 1511 E 11th St, Suite 100, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: House of Neighborly Service - Berthoud
resources.description: Food pantry and emergency assistance (rent, utilities, clothing) for Berthoud-area residents.
resources.address: 375 Meadowlark Dr, Berthoud, CO 80513

resources.name: Loveland's Community Kitchen
resources.description: Free hot dinner every day of the week for anyone who is hungry. No questions asked.
resources.address: 427 Garfield Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Salvation Army - Loveland
resources.description: Food pantry, emergency assistance and seasonal help for the Loveland and Berthoud area.
resources.address: 840 N Lincoln Ave, Suite 101, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Loveland Vineyard Church Food Pantry
resources.description: Food boxes with nonperishables, plus meat, eggs, produce and bread when they have it. Open to anyone who says they have a need.
resources.address: 900 Josephine Ct, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Adventist Community Services - Loveland
resources.description: Free food baskets and clothing. Bring a photo ID, Social Security cards for household members, and proof of monthly income.
resources.address: 950 N Cleveland Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Wellington Food Pantry (Boys & Girls Club)
resources.description: Free groceries for Wellington and northern Larimer County. Temporarily at Eyestone South while the new pantry at 3520 Harrison Ave is finished; call to confirm the location.
resources.address: 4001 W Wilson Ave, Wellington, CO 80549

resources.name: Crossroads Ministry of Estes Park
resources.description: Food pantry plus emergency help with rent, utilities, prescriptions and transportation for Estes Valley residents.
resources.address: 1753 Wildfire Rd, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: LaPorte Presbyterian Church Food Pantry
resources.description: Twice-monthly food pantry serving LaPorte, Bellvue and northwest Fort Collins. Open to anyone in need.
resources.address: 3820 W County Rd 54G, LaPorte, CO 80535

resources.name: North 40 Food Pantry (Red Feather Lakes / Livermore)
resources.description: Food pantry for mountain residents in Red Feather Lakes, Livermore and the Poudre Canyon area. Red Feather location is in the Chapel in the Pines basement (east parking lot).
resources.address: 23947 W County Rd 74E, Red Feather Lakes, CO 80545

resources.name: Grace Place Mobile Food Pantry (Berthoud)
resources.description: Food Bank for Larimer County mobile pantry in Berthoud with free produce and groceries.
resources.address: 375 Meadowlark Dr, Berthoud, CO 80513

resources.name: Meals on Wheels - Fort Collins
resources.description: Hot, nutritious meals delivered to homebound adults in Fort Collins. Sliding-scale pricing; no one is turned away for inability to pay.
resources.address: 1217 E Elizabeth St, Unit 11, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Meals on Wheels - Loveland & Berthoud
resources.description: Home-delivered meals for people in Loveland and Berthoud who cannot shop or cook for themselves. Pay what you can.
resources.address: 437 N Garfield Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: WIC - Larimer County
resources.description: Free healthy food, nutrition help and breastfeeding support for pregnant women, new moms, infants and kids under 5. Fort Collins office at 1525 Blue Spruce Dr; Loveland/Estes/Berthoud call 970-619-4590.
resources.address: 1525 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Hunger Free Colorado Food Resource Hotline
resources.description: Statewide hotline that helps you apply for SNAP (food stamps) and find pantries and meal programs near you. Multilingual.

resources.name: McBackpack
resources.description: Weekend food bags for Poudre School District students who need them. Ask your child's school counselor or front office to sign up.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: Larimer County Human Services - Benefits
resources.description: Apply for SNAP (food stamps), Medicaid / Health First Colorado, TANF cash assistance, child care assistance and more. Offices in Fort Collins (1501 Blue Spruce Dr), Loveland (200 Peridot Ave) and Estes Park (1601 Brodie Ave).
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Colorado PEAK (apply online)
resources.description: Apply for and manage Colorado benefits online: SNAP, Medicaid, cash assistance, child care and more. You can also check your case status and upload documents.

resources.name: Social Security Administration - Fort Collins
resources.description: Apply for SSI, SSDI and retirement benefits, replace a Social Security card, or check on a claim. Appointments are strongly recommended; call the local office or 1-800-772-1213.
resources.address: 301 S Howes St, 4th Floor, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: City of Fort Collins Rebate Program
resources.description: Yearly cash rebates on sales tax, utilities and property tax/rent for income-qualified Fort Collins residents. One application covers all rebates.
resources.address: 215 N Mason St, 2nd Floor, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Get FoCo
resources.description: One application for City of Fort Collins income-qualified programs: reduced-rate Recreation passes, utility discounts, Spin bike/scooter access, the Rebate Program and more.

resources.name: Larimer Health Connect
resources.description: Free, unbiased help enrolling in Health First Colorado (Medicaid), CHP+ or a Connect for Health Colorado marketplace plan. Walk in or make an appointment.
resources.address: 144 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: UCHealth Financial Assistance
resources.description: Discounts or free care on UCHealth hospital and clinic bills for patients who qualify by income. You can apply before or after you get a bill.

resources.name: Make Change NOCO - Free Tax Preparation
resources.description: Free IRS-certified tax preparation (VITA) so you can claim the Earned Income Credit, Child Tax Credit and Colorado credits like TABOR and the Family Affordability Credit.
resources.address: 2601 S Lemay Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Tax season (Jan-Apr) by appointment; year-round help by phone

resources.name: LEAP - Low-income Energy Assistance Program
resources.description: Helps pay winter heating bills (Nov 1 - Apr 30). Getting LEAP in Fort Collins also automatically enrolls you in the Utilities Income-Qualified Assistance Program for a discount on your city bill.

resources.name: Fort Collins Utilities Payment Assistance Fund
resources.description: One-time help paying a past-due Fort Collins Utilities bill, administered by Catholic Charities. Bring your shut-off or past-due notice.
resources.address: 460 Linden Center Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Fort Collins Utilities Income-Qualified Assistance Program
resources.description: Roughly 25% off electric, water and wastewater rates on your Fort Collins Utilities bill. Enroll through LEAP or Get FoCo.
resources.address: 222 Laporte Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Loveland Water & Power - HAND Program
resources.description: Help paying Loveland utility bills for residents with low income, disability or over 60. Administered with House of Neighborly Service.
resources.address: 200 N Wilson Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Energy Outreach Colorado
resources.description: Bill payment help when LEAP isn't enough, plus free furnace/water heater repair or replacement for income-qualified homeowners (crisis line 855-469-4328).

resources.name: Xcel Energy - Payment Plans & Assistance
resources.description: If Xcel is your gas provider, call to set up a payment plan, request a medical hold, or ask about the Energy Assistance and Percentage of Income Payment programs.

resources.name: Housing Catalyst
resources.description: Fort Collins' housing authority. Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8), affordable apartments, and permanent supportive housing for Fort Collins, Wellington and Larimer County.
resources.address: 1715 W Mountain Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Loveland Housing Authority
resources.description: Section 8 vouchers, affordable rentals and senior housing for the Loveland area. Also runs the Larimer Home Improvement Program for low-cost home repair loans.
resources.address: 375 W 37th St, Suite 200, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Estes Park Housing Authority
resources.description: Affordable rentals, down-payment help and rental assistance programs for people who live or work in the Estes Valley.
resources.address: 363 E Elkhorn Ave, Suite 101, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: CARE Housing
resources.description: Affordable apartments for working families in Fort Collins and Larimer County, with resident services and community support.
resources.address: 1303 W Swallow Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Neighbor to Neighbor - Fort Collins
resources.description: Emergency rent assistance, eviction prevention, housing search help, first-time homebuyer classes and foreclosure counseling. Start with a phone call or walk in.
resources.address: 1550 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Neighbor to Neighbor - Loveland
resources.description: Rent and utility assistance, eviction prevention and housing counseling for Loveland, Berthoud and southern Larimer County.
resources.address: 375 W 37th St, Suite 100, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Fort Collins Habitat for Humanity
resources.description: Affordable homeownership with a zero-interest mortgage for families who put in sweat-equity hours, plus a home repair program. Call about the next application window.
resources.address: 131 Lincoln Ave, Suite 200, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Loveland Habitat for Humanity
resources.description: Affordable homeownership and home repair programs for the Loveland and Berthoud area.
resources.address: 108 W 29th St, Unit D, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Volunteers of America - Northern Colorado
resources.description: Supportive housing and rapid re-housing for veterans (SSVF), affordable senior housing, and Meals on Wheels partnerships across Larimer and Weld counties.
resources.address: 405 Canyon Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Colorado Poverty Law Project - Eviction Help
resources.description: Free legal help for tenants facing eviction, illegal lockouts or unsafe housing. Statewide tenant help line.

resources.name: Larimer County Emergency Housing Assistance (CSBG)
resources.description: Short-term help with rent, deposits or mortgage payments for Larimer County residents facing a housing crisis. Ask Human Services about Community Services Block Grant funds.
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Fort Collins Rescue Mission
resources.description: Overnight shelter and meals for men. The Jefferson St building is temporarily closed after a fire in August 2026; sign up for a bed at the Murphy Center (Mon-Fri 8am-2pm) or call 970-689-2842. Check-in is at 117 N Mason St, 5:30-7pm.
resources.address: 117 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Catholic Charities - The Mission / Samaritan House
resources.description: Overnight shelter for women and families with children, hot meals, case management and help with IDs and utilities. Same building houses the Fort Collins Utilities payment assistance program.
resources.address: 460 Linden Center Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Family Housing Network
resources.description: Shelter and a day center for families with children under 18 who are experiencing homelessness, plus help getting back into stable housing.
resources.address: 1606 S Lemay Ave, Suite 103, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Day center Mon-Fri; call for intake

resources.name: Murphy Center for Hope (Homeward Alliance)
resources.description: Day resource center for anyone experiencing or at risk of homelessness: showers, laundry, mail, phone, lockers, bus passes, benefits help, job search help and 20+ partner agencies under one roof.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Loveland Resource Center & Overnight Shelter
resources.description: Daytime resource center with showers, laundry, meals and case management, plus an overnight shelter for adults in Loveland.
resources.address: 137 S Lincoln Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Loveland Overnight Shelter - South Railroad
resources.description: City of Loveland overnight shelter for adults. Doors open at 7pm.
resources.address: 300 S Railroad Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Family Promise of Larimer County (HNS)
resources.description: Shelter and rehousing program for families with children in Loveland and southern Larimer County, run by House of Neighborly Service.
resources.address: 1511 E 11th St, Suite 200, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Harvest Farm - New Life Program
resources.description: Free long-term residential recovery program for men overcoming homelessness and addiction, on a working farm near Wellington (Denver Rescue Mission).
resources.address: 4240 E County Rd 66, Wellington, CO 80549

resources.name: Larimer County Economic & Workforce Development
resources.description: Free job search help, resume and interview coaching, training scholarships (WIOA), youth programs and hiring events. Computers, printers and phones available for job seekers. Loveland services are at the 200 Peridot Ave campus.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, Suite 5000, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Connecting Colorado
resources.description: Colorado's official job board. Create a profile, search openings statewide and register for workforce center services. Required for unemployment work-search.

resources.name: Colorado Division of Vocational Rehabilitation - Loveland
resources.description: Free help finding and keeping a job if you have a disability: career counseling, training, assistive technology, job coaching and Ticket to Work. Serves Fort Collins, Loveland and Estes Park.
resources.address: 5250 Hahns Peak Dr, Suite 120, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Disabled Resource Services - Fort Collins
resources.description: Independent living center run by and for people with disabilities: benefits counseling (SSI/SSDI), peer support, skills training, advocacy, and help with Medicaid waivers and home modifications.
resources.address: 1017 Robertson St, Unit B, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Disabled Resource Services - Loveland
resources.description: Independent living services for people with disabilities in Loveland, Berthoud and Estes Park: benefits help, peer support, advocacy and equipment loans.
resources.address: 1647 E 18th St, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Spirit Crossing Clubhouse
resources.description: Free membership community for adults living with mental illness. Members build work skills, get help finding transitional and supported employment, and share meals. Peer-run.
resources.address: 1148 E Elizabeth St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
